info.title: ArchGen.Cli
info.description: Opinionated multi-architecture scaffolding CLI for .NET. Generates N-Tier, Clean Architecture, CQRS, or Minimal API projects with configurable persistence (JSON, SQLite, PostgreSQL) and UI type (Console, Minimal API, WinForms, WPF, Blazor Server).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: archgen — opinionated multi-architecture scaffolding CLI for .NET. Generates N-Tier, Clean Architecture, CQRS, or Minimal API projects with configurable persistence and UI type. Run with no arguments for an interactive menu.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Architecture pattern to scaffold (ntier, clean-architecture, cqrs, minimal-api).

options.name: --ui
options.description: UI project type to scaffold on top of the architecture.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory where the project folder will be created.

options.name: --git
options.description: Initialize git and publish to GitHub (requires 'gh' installed and authenticated).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the project to generate.
